rows.en: Users of Change Healthcare & other services

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: UnitedHealthの子会社と合併し、完全子会社になる合併契約を2023年に締結
relations.text_en: Signed a 2023 merger agreement to become a wholly owned subsidiary of UnitedHealth

source.label: Amedisys 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: pursuant to which Merger Sub will merge with and into Amedisys (the "Merger") with Amedisys continuing as the surviving corporation and becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of UnitedHealth Group.

relations.text: 2025年10月、UnitedHealthとAmedisysが手放した事業の一部をPennantが買収(移行サービス契約も締結)
relations.text_en: Pennant bought certain operations of UnitedHealth and Amedisys in October 2025, with a transition services agreement

source.label: Pennant Group 10-Q(2026年第3四半期)
source.quote: On October 1, 2025, the Company acquired certain operations of UnitedHealth, Amedisys, Inc.

relations.text: 2019年に医療グループ(DMG)をUnitedHealth傘下のOptumに売却
relations.text_en: Sold its DaVita Medical Group business to UnitedHealth's Optum in 2019

source.label: DaVita 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On June 19, 2019 , the Company completed the sale of its prior DMG business to Optum.

relations.text: UnitedHealth傘下のChange Healthcareを、保険請求の仲介に使っている
relations.text_en: Uses UnitedHealth's Change Healthcare as an intermediary for insurance claims

source.label: Bioventus 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Change Healthcare, a subsidiary of UnitedHealth Group that acts as an intermediary for processing certain of our claims for reimbursement related to our EXOGEN device to commercial payers

companies.name: モリーナ・ヘルスケア
companies.sub: 医療保険(メディケイド)

relations.text: Molinaが10-Kで、メディケイドの主な競合としてUnitedHealthを挙げる
relations.text_en: Molina names UnitedHealth among its main Medicaid managed care competitors

source.label: Molina Healthcare 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors in the Medicaid managed care industry include Centene Corporation, CVS Health Corporation, Elevance Health, Inc., UnitedHealth Group Inc., and large not-for-profit healthcare organizations.

relations.text: Clover Healthが10-Kで、競合の全国大手保険会社としてUnitedHealthを挙げる
relations.text_en: Clover Health names UnitedHealth among the large national insurers it competes with

source.label: Clover Health 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include large, national insurers, such as UnitedHealth, Aetna, Humana, Cigna, Centene, and Elevance Health

relations.text: HealthEquityが10-Kで、直接の競合としてUnitedHealthのOptumを挙げる
relations.text_en: HealthEquity names UnitedHealth's Optum among its direct competitors

source.label: HealthEquity 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: healthcare service companies such as UnitedHealth Group's Optum and Webster Bank

companies.name: オプション・ケア・ヘルス

relations.text: Option Careが10-Kで、在宅点滴の競合としてOptum Infusion Pharmacyを挙げる
relations.text_en: Option Care names Optum Infusion Pharmacy among its home infusion competitors

source.label: Option Care Health 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The Company's competitors within the home infusion market include Optum Infusion Pharmacy (a unit of the United Healthcare Insurance Company)

relations.text: TruBridgeが10-Kで、医療コーディング製品の主な競合としてOptumを挙げる
relations.text_en: TruBridge names Optum as a primary competitor for its encoder products

source.label: TruBridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The primary competitors for our encoder solutions include Solventum and Optum.

companies.name: SS&Cテクノロジーズ
companies.sub: 金融・医療ソフトウェア

relations.text: SS&Cが10-Kで、薬剤給付管理サービスの競合としてOptumRxを挙げる
relations.text_en: SS&C names UnitedHealth's OptumRx among competing pharmacy-benefit vendors

source.label: SS&C Technologies 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We compete with other third-party vendors such as Evernorth Express Scripts/Cigna, CVS Caremark, UnitedHealth/OptumRx and companies that perform their services in-house

relations.text: Astranaが10-Kで、ロサンゼルス地域の競合としてOptumを挙げる
relations.text_en: Astrana names Optum among its competitors in greater Los Angeles

source.label: Astrana Health 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In the greater Los Angeles area, such competitors include Regal Medical Group and Lakeside Medical Group, which are part of Heritage Provider Network ("Heritage"), as well as Optum, a subsidiary of UnitedHealth Group.

relations.text: NeueHealthが10-Kで、競合としてOptumHealthを挙げる
relations.text_en: NeueHealth names OptumHealth among its competitors

source.label: NeueHealth 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: These competitors include companies such as Agilon Health, ChenMed, One Medical, OptumHealth, and VillageMD.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
